Luxurious Adelaide Hills Escape Just 30 Minutes from CBD

Adelaide Hills, Australia

Unwind at The Crafers Hotel, a gorgeous heritage hotel in the Adelaide Hills - a picture-perfect leafy haven less than 30 minutes' drive from the city. Built in the 19th century, the hotel was one of Adelaide's first pubs and is steeped in history. The interior pays tribute to its past with a Wine Room serving a variety of rare and classic local and international wines. Beer and cider enthusiasts need not miss out: pull up a seat in the historic pub and check out the extensive, everchanging drinks menu alongside a mouthwatering French-inspired dining menu. The treasures of Adelaide Hills are also at your fingertips. Spend days following winding roads flanked by pine trees to renowned wineries like The Lane Vineyard (only a 15-minute drive from the hotel), plus countless distilleries, microbreweries, chocolatiers, fromageries and more.
